caption: The drawing displays a long, brown dress as the central object, depicted in detail with accentuated vertical patterns and texture. The dress features puffed sleeves with layered, rounded sections and a fitted bodice. The structure and decorative elements of the sleeves are highly detailed, showing multiple folds and gathered fabric. The skirt is floor-length, slightly flared, and includes vertical stripes and floral motifs within the stripes. To the right of the main dress illustration, there is a simpler, outlined sketch of the same dress, showing the basic structure and proportions without color or texture. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a handwritten note at the lower right corner with the words "Federal Art Project W.P.A. of VA. By--Mary Humes."
title: Dress
